page.notes: The marginal note at left is set in small type and runs across the last lines of the page; it is placed at the start of the final paragraph. Long s has been written as plain s throughout (e.g. "destinato", "instituitur", "descriptione"). The word "Baf-" at the lower right is the catchword, shown as "Bassæus" with the hyphen dropped; the final line of text ends at "Eligius". The line-end hyphens in "dimi-cantium", "ag-grediatur", "de capi-te" and "Flori-bus" are joined in the transcription.
